rules.source_behavior: When enabled, keys by raw request URL and appends an MD5 of the body byte-array string when the proxy captured a non-null POST body; optional auth data is appended when AUTH is enabled.
rules.package_behavior: Independent selected-field SHA-256 fingerprint over method, normalized URL, Content-Type, body-capture state, body bytes, and optional configured headers; authentication is a separate partition.
rules.difference: Fingerprint fields, encoding, and mode composition differ.
rules.source: HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: HASH key construction; Utils.java: calcReqInfoHash

rules.source_behavior: When enabled, immediately drops every request whose Burp parameter list is empty, including the first; parameterized requests continue to other enabled modes.
rules.package_behavior: Independent strategy: parameterized or incomplete requests pass; a complete empty request is allowed once per group and endpoint after commit, then repeats drop.
rules.difference: First complete empty request passes in this package; strategies do not compose.
rules.source: HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: REQ_PARAM early return before SMART/HASH

rules.source_behavior: Keys by URL without query, Burp content type, and optional auth map; parameter values become a presence marker, keys are flattened by name, and newly seen names are merged cumulatively.
rules.package_behavior: Independent coverage keyed by normalized endpoint, auth group, method, scheme/host/port/path, and media type; coverage identity retains parameter location and name, ignores values, and tracks the empty shape.
rules.difference: Reference key omits method and flattened names lose location identity; package partitions by method and preserves locations.
rules.source: HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: SMART key construction; Utils.java: IParametersToJsonStr/isUniqReqInfo

rules.source_behavior: Optional auth extraction selects parameter and header names matching token|auth|sessid|session case-insensitively; Proxy-Authorization also matches the auth substring.
rules.package_behavior: Cookie, Authorization, common token/auth/session headers, custom names, and caller AuthenticationGroupID create the group; Proxy-Authorization is excluded.
rules.difference: Package handles whole Cookie/Authorization sources and deliberately excludes proxy credentials.

cases.name: same parameter name in query and form keeps distinct locations
cases.reference_policy: If Burp returns both IParameter entries, reference SMART flattens both into one JSON key by name and replaces both values with the same marker; this package intentionally includes location in shape identity.

cases.name: SMART reference key omits HTTP method
cases.reference_policy: If both Burp requests expose the same parameter name and content type, reference SMART uses the same URL-without-query/content-type key and can drop the second request; this package intentionally partitions SMART coverage by HTTP method.
